title: It works thus far. Feels a bit flimsy.
text: It works thus far. Feels a bit flimsy.. These definitely get the job done. They feel a bit flimsy, but are holding up so far. I use them for flats, sandals and other lightweight shoes. I will make one note -- read the instructions! It's easy to put the part that has the hangar in upside down and it pokes through/rips the fabric if you do, make sure it's in the right way.
